channel.title: Worcester Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Worcester Business Journal (wbjournal.com)

item.title: Central Mass. home sales slow to start 2026
item.description: Central Massachusetts saw a slower-than-usual start to the 2026 single-family real estate season.

item.title: Worcester-Boston worker compensation costs up 3.6%, slightly above national rate
item.description: Increases in wages and salaries should help workers dealing with increasing costs of living.

item.title: 🔒 American Eagle Outfitters to close Devens fulfillment center, lay off 100+ employees
item.description: AE Regional Distribution Co., a subsidiary of apparel company American Eagle Outfitters, is closing its Devens fulfillment facility, laying off 103 employees in the process.

item.title: 🔒 Saint Vincent Hospital found to have violated 14 labor practices
item.description: A judge has determined the Worcester hospital infringed 14 labor practices between February 2022 and September 2023.

item.title: 🔒 Westborough electronics manufacturer acquired by Connecticut private equity firm
item.description: NEOTech has been acquired by Connecticut-based private equity firm Arkview Capital.

item.title: 🔒 Worcester immigration attorney buys new office for $2M to help meet demand
item.description: “I hope this will be our home for a long time, and will communicate to the immigrant community that we're here to stay,” Mooradian said.

item.title: Worcester robotics firm buys Westborough industrial site for $2.5M
item.description: The owner of a Worcester-based robotic parts and tools firm has purchased an industrial building at 62 Hopkinton Road in Westborough for $2.5 million.

item.title: 🔒 Two Gardner packaging facilities to close, lay off 90+ employees
item.description: Produce packaging manufacturer Garlock Flexibles has announced it will close two of its Gardner facilities as the firm is set to lay off 91 employees.

item.title: 🔒 Worcester chamber joins statewide apprenticeship program
item.description: The Worcester Regional Chamber of Commerce has joined its Boston counterpart in becoming part of the Massachusetts Apprenticeship Network, which seeks to help employers develop the workforce talent they need.

item.title: UniBank picks Augustus as next CEO
item.description: Augustus replaces Michael Welch, who announced his pending resignation in January.
